<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex71032024-10-31-14-43" status="unreviewed"> 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4235">khu ston brtson 'grus</rs> na re nor ma nor mtshon pa yin zer la 

               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3788">rngog legs pa'i shes rab</rs> na re sbyor mal yod pa'i chos dang mtshon pa yon no zer te de yang nus pa <lb edRef="inst:5176" n="39b4"/> las gro bas 'gro gsung ngo || 

               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4268">sna chung ston pa</rs> na re 'gros mtshon pa yin te rab ka mtho lta bu yin lo de'i go ba ni 'bras bus sher phyin gyi rtogs pa de sbyor bas skyed pa yin pas de la blo rtse yin gsung ngo || 
               
              <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3745">ti pang ka ra</rs> na re sbyor pas dis bud d+ha skyed byed du mtshon pa yin gsung ste ming gis dogs lugs las don thams cad la khyad med do gsung ngo ||</seg></TEI>
